source:
@@U01820@@
God’s wrath seizes you! The trumpet sounds! The graves quake! And your heart, roused from its ashes to suffer the tormenting flames, leaps up in agony!

@@U01822@@
O God, to be out of here! I feel the organ suffocating me, the choir dissolving my soul to its very depths!

@@U01828@@
I'm stifling! The columns closing around me! The ceiling crashing down on me! Air!

@@U01830@@
Hide yourself! Sin and shame cannot stay hidden. Air? Light? Woe to you!

@@U01836@@
The Blest turn their faces from you. The Pure shudder
translation:
@@U01820@@
神的愤怒抓住了你！号角吹响了！坟墓震动！而你的心，从灰烬中醒来，承受着痛苦的火焰，痛苦地跳了起来！

@@U01822@@
上帝啊，离开这里吧！我感觉管风琴让我窒息，合唱团让我的灵魂深深溶解！

@@U01828@@
我闷死了！柱子围住了我！天花板轰然倒塌砸在我身上！空气！

@@U01830@@
隐藏自己！罪恶和羞耻是无法隐藏的。空气？光？你有祸了！

@@U01836@@
至福者转过脸不看你。纯粹的颤抖
